**Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues.**

Please do not post details of a vulnerability here. Public issues can be read by anyone.

Report it privately instead:

1. Open the affected repository on GitHub.
2. Go to the **Security** tab.
3. Select **Report a vulnerability**.

Read the full process in the security policy: https://github.com/Iridium-Group/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md

Please close this issue without submitting it.
